coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell or box: its printed edges. Tick box: the printed square.
how_measured: Picture pages: white boxes found as connected white regions in each embedded image at its own resolution (807-821 x 1042 px), edges refined to the white/grey transition, converted through each image's placement; every picture looked at; overlays looked at.

signing.kind: Corporate Capital Trust II subscription agreement printed from a browser: five form pages, each one picture (white fill-in boxes on grey). Investor and co-investor initial four representations and sign page 3 of the form; the investor representative and principal sign page 4; optional e-delivery consent on page 5. No issuer acceptance block.
signing.note: Each picture sits whole on one PDF page (pages 2, 5, 8, 11, 13); the PDF pages between them carry only print headers.
